assumptions.assumption: The public web server is reachable from the internet.
assumptions.basis: It is described as the public site, and readers hit the web server over HTTPS.
It holds accounts and comments, which are personal or person-related data, as well as operating content.
It holds published assets that readers fetch from the CDN.

assumptions.assumption: The CDN is controlled by a different service provider or tenant.
assumptions.basis: The CDN is described as a distinct content delivery service with its own bucket rather than as part of the hosted network.
